description: Manages system-wide settings and parameters that define the behavior and appearance of the application.

endpoints.name: Get
endpoints.description: Retrieves the current system configuration settings. This endpoint provides a read-only view of how the application is configured, including various parameters and preferences.
example_uses: How do I get the current system configuration?
Show me all the application settings.
Can I see the global parameters for the system?
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint when you need to retrieve the current operational settings or parameters of the application, such as default values, feature flags, or system-wide preferences.
